t: You are standing at St Gertrude's Church, a Catholic church in Bermondsey. It was designed by Francis William Tasker, an English architect who lived from 1848 to 1904. He specialised in Catholic churches built in England in the late nineteenth century. He also designed St Peter and the Guardian Angels in nearby Rotherhithe, so this building is one of a pair of his local works. If you visit both, you can compare them.
